gates.method: getAccountInfo Feature accounts (encoding=base64). effective_epoch = epoch(activated_slot) + 1. Observed mean slot is corroboration only — never gate proof.
gates.changelog_quote: Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.
gates.disclaimer: Do not treat observed ~367 ms as proof the 350 ms gate is live. Do not copy solana.com/upgrades/reduced-slot-times if it lists 400 ms as current.

editorial.summary: First-party Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026: “Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.” On-chain Feature accounts: 400ms=superseded, 350ms=live, 300ms=live, 250ms=pending, 200ms=pending. Observed mean slot ~316 ms is corroboration only — not feature-gate proof. Alpenglow (SIMD-0326) remains the consensus rewrite (Votor / Rotor); it is a separate track from the slot-time feature gates.

timeline_public.item: Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026: “Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.”
solana.com/news “Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic” remains a listing-token write-up for SIMD-525 (SIMD-0525).
SIMD-0525 created (Anza). Four feature gates: 350/300/250/200 ms.
Observed mean slot ~316 ms is corroboration only — not feature-gate proof. INFERRED corroboration, not a feature-gate RPC.
SIMD-0387 (BLS pubkey in vote account) activated on mainnet.
SIMD-0357 VAT activated. VAT does not itself turn on Alpenglow consensus.

watch: Whether the 300 ms gate (effective epoch 1024 when activated at epoch-1023 start) is live once that epoch starts.
Skip rate / skipped slots as later 50 ms steps (250/200) get Feature accounts on mainnet.
Do not treat observed slot ms as activation proof.
Firedancer / Frankendancer Votor parity before a full Alpenswitch.
editorial.disclaimer: Editorial. Gate labels come from getAccountInfo Feature accounts (effective epoch = activation epoch + 1). Observed slot ms is INFERRED corroboration, not proof. Ignore solana.com/upgrades/reduced-slot-times if it lists 400 ms as current.
